37,MR62,,Entrance / procession,E01,LOW MASS; SOLEMN MASS,"MR62 prescribes the procession to the altar: the vested priest carries the prepared Chalice at Low Mass with the minister preceding; at Solemn Mass he processes with deacon and subdeacon, preceded by acolytes with lighted candles. 39,MR62,,Collect(s),E11,ALL FORMS; SOLEMN VARIANT,"For the Collect(s), the celebrant says Oremus, extends his hands before his breast and says the prayer; he joins his hands at the conclusion and bows the head at specified sacred names. The same rules of voice, hand extension and bows apply to additional Collects. In Solemn Mass the deacon and subdeacon stand behind him; at Flectamus genua all kneel as prescribed.",CONTROLLING 1962 RITUAL,Ritus V.1–5; PDF p. 7; web lines 303–327,https://archive.ccwatershed.org/pdfs/5276-ritus-servandus-translated-english/download/
40,MR62,,Gospel preparation (Solemn),E16,LOW MASS; SOLEMN MASS,"At Low Mass the celebrant returns to the middle, raises and lowers his eyes, bows profoundly and says Munda cor meum quietly before going to the Gospel side. In Solemn Mass the deacon kneels on the highest step for Munda cor meum, receives the celebrant's blessing, and proceeds to the Gospel with thurifer, acolytes and subdeacon.",CONTROLLING 1962 RITUAL,"Ritus VI.2, VI.5; PDF pp. 7–9; web lines 336–345, 392–403",https://archive.ccwatershed.org/pdfs/5276-ritus-servandus-translated-english/download/
41,MR62,,Celebrant's private Gospel (Solemn),E17,SOLEMN MASS,"The 1962 Solemn-Mass sequence does not prescribe a separate private Gospel reading by the celebrant. 42,MR62,,In spiritu humilitatis / Veni sanctificator,E26,ALL FORMS,"After the chalice offering the celebrant, with joined hands placed on the altar and bowing somewhat, says In spiritu humilitatis quietly; then standing erect, raising his eyes and hands and joining them, he says Veni, Sanctificator and blesses the Host and Chalice together at benedic.",CONTROLLING 1962 RITUAL,Ritus VII.5; PDF p. 10; web lines 470–482,https://archive.ccwatershed.org/pdfs/5276-ritus-servandus-translated-english/download/
43,MR62,,Offertory incensation (when used),E27,SOLEMN MASS; MISSA CANTATA WITH INCENSE,"At the Offertory incensation the celebrant blesses incense, incenses the gifts with six prescribed swings/cross-circuits, then the Cross and altar; the deacon removes/replaces the Chalice while the Cross is incensed, the celebrant is incensed, then clergy, subdeacon, deacon, acolytes and people in order. In sung Mass when incense is used, the celebrant follows the Solemn-Mass procedure and is incensed by the minister.",CONTROLLING 1962 RITUAL,Ritus VII.10–11; PDF pp. 12–13; web lines 561–599,https://archive.ccwatershed.org/pdfs/5276-ritus-servandus-translated-english/download/
44,MR62,,Lavabo,E28,ALL FORMS; REQUIEM/PASSIONTIDE EXCEPTIONS,"For the Lavabo the celebrant goes with joined hands to the Epistle side, stands there and washes the ends of the fingers including thumbs and index fingers while the minister pours water, reciting Psalm 25; the Gloria Patri is omitted in Masses for the dead and from Passion Sunday through Holy Thursday inclusive.",CONTROLLING 1962 RITUAL,Ritus VII.6; PDF pp. 10–11; web lines 483–496,https://archive.ccwatershed.org/pdfs/5276-ritus-servandus-translated-english/download/
45,MR62,,Orate fratres / Suscipiat,E29,ALL FORMS,"After Suscipe sancta Trinitas the celebrant turns toward the people with eyes cast down, extends and joins his hands and says Orate, fratres in a somewhat elevated voice; he completes the formula quietly while turning back to the altar.
